subject.title: fix(update): guard Windows task autostart during package updates

question: Should this replay land after removing the release-owned changelog entry, with the documented Windows Scheduled Task recovery limit accepted?
rationale: The patch fixes a source-backed Windows update race, but it temporarily mutates durable Task Scheduler enabled state and the PR has a protected maintainer label, so automation should not own the merge-risk decision.

options.title: Land Replay After Changelog Cleanup
options.body: Remove the CHANGELOG.md line, keep the update-scoped disable/restore implementation, and accept the hard-termination recovery limit as an operator-support risk.

options.title: Require Full Native Update Smoke
options.body: Hold merge until a Windows OpenClaw package-update transcript covers suspension, package replacement, restoration, and restart or --no-restart behavior.

options.title: Return To Older Draft
options.body: Pause this replay and continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88292 if maintainers prefer that branch as the canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Land Replay After Changelog Cleanup
